findings.evidence: UN Regulation No. 161 is 'protection of motor vehicles against unauthorized use ... device against unauthorized use (by mean of a locking system)', unrelated to accelerator return-to-idle. Repo itself uses R161 for unauthorized use in knowledge/crosswalk.yaml:1051.

findings.proposed: UN R60 (motorcycle/moped driver-operated controls and indicators)
findings.evidence: FMVSS 123 is motorcycle controls and displays ('S1 ... location, operation, identification, and illumination of motorcycle controls and displays'). UN R121 covers identification of controls/tell-tales for M and N vehicles; R60 is the L-category counterpart (from standard knowledge, not searched).

Body: 'S1 ... performance requirements for motorcycle brake systems'; 'S3 applies to motorcycles'. UN R13 covers M/N/O heavy vehicle braking; R78 is the motorcycle braking regulation (standard knowledge, not searched).
Motorcycle brake standard has no UN equivalent listed; R78 (braking of L1-L5 vehicles) is the counterpart (standard knowledge, not searched).

Body S1: 'devices that can be installed on school buses ... stop signal arm'. R150 is retro-reflecting devices and R148 is light-signalling devices; neither regulates school-bus stop arms. No UN counterpart known (standard knowledge, not searched).

findings.proposed: UN R54 (commercial vehicle tyres); add UN R75 for motorcycle tyres; drop R30
findings.evidence: Body S3(a): 'New pneumatic tires for ... GVWR of more than 4,536 kilograms'; also motorcycle tyres. UN R30 covers passenger-car (M1) tyres, outside FMVSS 119 scope (standard knowledge, not searched).
Body S3: applies to passenger cars and MPVs/trucks/buses with GVWR 3,500 kg or less; UN R13-H is the counterpart. No un_equivalent entry present.
Body S1: 'minimize the likelihood of death or injury from their accidental operation'; no theft-prevention content (remote actuation concerns inadvertent operation).
Body covers motorcycle service/parking brake systems incl. ABS; ABS is a brake feature, not ADAS, and tires/wheels are not regulated by this standard.
Standard regulates brake systems; tires and wheels are only test conditions.

findings.proposed: Keep, but note this is the legacy standard for motorcycles not certified to 571.122
findings.evidence: Title duplicates 571.122's name; body: 'does not apply to motorcycles certified to comply with § 571.122'. Distinct disambiguation helps users.

notes: All 14 bodies contain actual eCFR regulation text; statuses in-force plausible; summaries consistent with bodies (truncated with ellipsis). Precheck had no flags for these items. Main systemic issue: un_equivalent_ai suggestions are unreliable for motorcycle/school bus standards (R13, R121, R150 etc. mapped to the wrong UN regulation). Most UN-equivalent corrections rely on standard knowledge, not searched.
